name: Experimental Setup 2
description: Experimental Setup 1 with the short WSG50_GELSIGHT_fin fingers and two GelSight Mini sensors.
units: m, rad, kg, s; fields suffixed deg are degrees

finger_source_to_sensor.note: Current short finger pocket registration from diffpatch_ex.mujoco_system.prepare_session_assets; inferred mating, not a measured installation transform.

mount.note: Nominal parallel sensors. Retains the source's inferred 14 mm carriage extension; does not import the recording-specific -3 degree sensor tilt.

gripper.note: Opening is the nominal WSG register (twice slide q). Equal opening and gel gap are an explicit uncalibrated default, adjustable using the reference fields.

sensor.note: Masses and inertia are source simulation assumptions. Gel is a rigid contact box; no optical tactile rendering or continuum deformation model.
